info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Baggages-v3-spec
info.description: The List Airline Flights Baggage API provides a comprehensive overview of checked baggage associated with specific airline flights. This endpoint enables users to retrieve detailed information about baggage allowances, restrictions, and any additional fees that may apply. Typical consumers of this API include travel agencies, airline systems, and mobile applications aimed at enhancing passenger experience. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can ensure compliance with baggage policies, improving customer service and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed baggage information associated with specific flights, including weight limits, allowed items, and any associated fees.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching information about baggage related to flights. This body should contain all necessary parameters to retrieve the specific baggage details.
